thirtyMeterSprint.name: 30m Sprint
thirtyMeterSprint.shortDescription: Time to cover 30 meters from a stationary start
thirtyMeterSprint.whyItMatters: Measures short-burst acceleration and first-step quickness crucial for beating opponents.
thirtyMeterSprint.instructions:
1. Place phone on a tripod at hip height 5m to the side of the 30m track.
2. Stand behind start line in stationary stance.
3. Sprint 30 meters at top speed on start signal.
4. AI timer records time the instant your chest crosses the 30m mark.

fiftyMeterSprint.name: 50m Sprint (Standing Start)
fiftyMeterSprint.shortDescription: Time to cover 50 meters from a stationary start
fiftyMeterSprint.whyItMatters: Speed and acceleration are fundamental across almost all sports for breakaways and field coverage.
fiftyMeterSprint.instructions:
1. Position phone 5-7 meters away perpendicular to the 50m track.
2. Stand behind the starting line in stationary position.
3. Sprint 50 meters as fast as possible on the signal.
4. AI camera crossing detection records time when chest crosses finish line.
fiftyMeterSprint.sourceReference: SAI Khelo India Fitness Test Battery

fiveTenFiveShuttleRun.name: 5-10-5 Shuttle Run
fiveTenFiveShuttleRun.shortDescription: Time to complete the 5-10-5 shuttle pattern
fiveTenFiveShuttleRun.whyItMatters: Agility allows athletes to change directions rapidly and dodge defenders.
fiveTenFiveShuttleRun.instructions:
1. Place phone 4m in front of center line.
2. Start at center line.
3. Sprint 5yd right, touch line, sprint 10yd left, touch line, sprint 5yd back.
4. AI tracks line touches and records completion time.

lateralMovement.name: Lateral Movement
lateralMovement.shortDescription: Time to complete lateral movement pattern
lateralMovement.whyItMatters: Lateral shuffling is essential for perimeter guarding, court positioning, and defensive reactions.
lateralMovement.instructions:
1. Place phone 3.5m in front of shuffle path.
2. Shuffle sideways between 3m markers touching lines.
3. AI measures completion time for prescribed touches.

verticalJump.name: Vertical Jump
verticalJump.shortDescription: Best of up to 3 jumps within 30 seconds
verticalJump.whyItMatters: Vertical jump capacity measures explosive lower-body power for spiking, rebounding, and heading.
verticalJump.instructions:
1. Position phone 3m away at chest height facing your side profile.
2. Perform up to 3 countermovement jumps within 30 seconds.
3. AI tracks maximum vertical displacement.

standingLongJump.name: Standing Long Jump
standingLongJump.shortDescription: Best of up to 3 jumps within 30 seconds
standingLongJump.whyItMatters: Broad jump reflects horizontal force production, crucial for sprinting acceleration and bounding.
standingLongJump.instructions:
1. Place phone 3m away viewing side profile of takeoff line.
2. Jump horizontally as far as possible landing on both feet.
3. AI measures peak horizontal takeoff-to-landing distance.

pushUps.name: Push-Ups (Boys) / Modified Push-Ups (Girls)
pushUps.shortDescription: Max correct reps until failure or exhaustion
pushUps.whyItMatters: Upper-body push strength builds contact resilience, shielding power, and arm stamina.
pushUps.instructions:
1. Boys perform standard push-ups (hands/toes). Girls perform modified push-ups with knees on floor.
2. Lower body until elbows bend to 90 degrees, then push up to full extension.
3. Continue performing reps steadily until exhaustion or form breaks.
4. AI pose tracking detects rep count and stops session upon form breakdown.
pushUps.statusNote: AI-tracked open-ended reps until form break
pushUps.sourceReference: SAI Khelo India Fitness Test Battery

squats.name: Squats (30s)
squats.whyItMatters: Leg strength forms the foundation for running speed, jumping height, and joint protection.
squats.instructions:
1. Place phone on a table 2.5m away at waist height.
2. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Squat down until thighs are parallel to floor and stand back up.
4. Complete as many valid reps as possible in 30 seconds.

partialCurlUp.name: Partial Curl-Up (30s)
partialCurlUp.whyItMatters: Evaluates abdominal muscular endurance and spine-protecting core stability.
partialCurlUp.instructions:
1. Lie flat on back with knees bent at 90 degrees, arms extended at sides.
2. Curl up smoothly until fingertips slide forward 6 inches to marked line.
3. Return back to starting position.
4. Complete as many strict reps as possible in 30 seconds.
partialCurlUp.sourceReference: SAI Khelo India Fitness Test Battery

plank.name: Plank
plank.shortDescription: Hold plank position as long as possible
plank.whyItMatters: A strong core transfers power efficiently between lower and upper body while protecting the lower back.
plank.instructions:
1. Prop on forearms and toes in a straight plank.
2. Open-ended timer counts up as long as valid posture is maintained.
3. AI stops timer automatically when hip sags.

singleLegBalance.name: Single-Leg Balance (Flamingo)
singleLegBalance.whyItMatters: Measures single-leg joint stability, leg strength, and postural control.
singleLegBalance.instructions:
1. Stand on preferred leg, bending free leg back at knee holding foot near buttocks.
2. 60-second window starts when instructor/app releases balance.
3. App counts each time balance is lost or foot touches ground.
4. Test terminates early if 15 or more falls occur in the first 30 seconds.
singleLegBalance.earlyTerminationRule: 15+ falls in first 30 seconds ends test early
singleLegBalance.sourceReference: SAI Khelo India Fitness Test Battery

flexibilityTest.name: Sit & Reach (Flexibility)
flexibilityTest.shortDescription: Reach distance past toes held for 5 seconds
flexibilityTest.whyItMatters: Measures lower back and hamstring flexibility to prevent injuries and maintain stride length.
flexibilityTest.instructions:
1. Sit on floor with legs straight ahead, soles flat against box.
2. Reach forward slowly with hands stacked palm-down as far as possible.
3. Hold peak reach position for 5 seconds.
4. Score is distance reached past toe line (positive) or short of toe line (negative).
flexibilityTest.sourceReference: SAI Khelo India Fitness Test Battery

shoulderMobility.name: Shoulder Mobility
shoulderMobility.shortDescription: Hold max stretch position for 5 seconds
shoulderMobility.whyItMatters: Good shoulder mobility prevents rotator cuff strain and improves overhead throwing and swinging power.
shoulderMobility.instructions:
1. Reach one arm overhead down back and other arm under up back.
2. Hold maximum stretch position for 5 seconds.
3. AI measures shoulder joint angle over 5 seconds.

reactionTest.name: Reaction Test
reactionTest.shortDescription: Response time to visual stimulus in milliseconds
reactionTest.whyItMatters: Quick reaction time enables players to respond faster to opponent moves, ball deflections, and starter signals.
reactionTest.instructions:
1. Rest finger over response button.
2. Tap screen instantly when visual prompt flashes.
3. System measures exact response latency in ms.

beepTest.name: Beep Test
beepTest.shortDescription: Highest level survived in progressive paced shuttle test
beepTest.whyItMatters: Maximal aerobic capacity (VO2 max) keeps athletes performing at peak speed throughout an entire match.
beepTest.instructions:
1. Run 20m shuttles in sync with progressive audio beeps.
2. Stop test manually when unable to reach line before audio beep.
3. System logs total elapsed duration and highest level completed.

sixHundredMeterRun.name: 600m Run
sixHundredMeterRun.shortDescription: Time to complete 600 meters in minutes:seconds
sixHundredMeterRun.whyItMatters: Measures cardiovascular endurance and aerobic pacing capability.
sixHundredMeterRun.instructions:
1. Start behind line on a measured 600m track.
2. Run or walk 600 meters as fast as possible.
3. Stop timer when crossing the 600m finish line.
sixHundredMeterRun.sourceReference: SAI Khelo India Fitness Test Battery

bmiTest.name: BMI Test (Body Composition)
bmiTest.shortDescription: Calculate Body Mass Index from Height & Weight
bmiTest.whyItMatters: Evaluates body composition and general physical health status to guide training and nutrition.
bmiTest.instructions:
1. Enter height in centimeters and weight in kilograms.
2. App calculates BMI = Weight(kg) / (Height(m))².
3. Healthy range: Boys 20-25, Girls 19-24.
bmiTest.sourceReference: SAI Khelo India Fitness Test Battery

heightTest.name: Height Test (Anthropometrics)
heightTest.whyItMatters: Tracks physical growth and determines eligibility/bands for certain age categories.
heightTest.instructions:
1. Stand barefoot against a wall.
2. Ensure heels, buttocks, shoulders, and head touch the wall.
3. Look straight ahead. Measure from floor to vertex of head.
heightTest.sourceFileDetails: Compiled from: Khelo India/SAI Basketball Retention & Induction Protocol, Volleyball Selection Criteria, SAI Battery Fitness Assessment Concept Note.

weightTest.name: Weight Test (Anthropometrics)
weightTest.whyItMatters: Used with height to calculate BMI and track physical development.
weightTest.instructions:
1. Stand still on a calibrated digital scale.
2. Ensure minimal clothing and no shoes.
3. Record weight to the nearest 0.1 kg.
weightTest.sourceFileDetails: Compiled from: Khelo India/SAI Basketball Retention & Induction Protocol, Volleyball Selection Criteria, SAI Battery Fitness Assessment Concept Note.

medicineBallThrow.name: Medicine Ball Throw (Backward Overhead)
medicineBallThrow.whyItMatters: Measures explosive upper-body and core strength.
medicineBallThrow.instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding medicine ball (1kg for U12, 2kg for 12+).
2. Lower into a squat, then explosively throw the ball backward over your head.
3. Record the distance from the throwing line to where the ball lands.
medicineBallThrow.sourceFileDetails: Compiled from: Khelo India/SAI Basketball Retention & Induction Protocol, Volleyball Selection Criteria, SAI Battery Fitness Assessment Concept Note.

fourByTenShuttle.name: 4x10m Shuttle Run
fourByTenShuttle.whyItMatters: Measures speed, agility, and ability to change direction rapidly.
fourByTenShuttle.instructions:
1. Place two markers 10 meters apart.
2. Sprint to the opposite marker, touch the line, and return (repeat for 4 total legs).
3. Timer stops when the athlete crosses the finish line on the final leg.
fourByTenShuttle.sourceFileDetails: Compiled from: Khelo India/SAI Basketball Retention & Induction Protocol, Volleyball Selection Criteria, SAI Battery Fitness Assessment Concept Note.

sitUps.name: Sit-Ups (30/45s)
sitUps.instructions:
1. Lie flat on back with knees bent.
2. Perform full sit-ups, touching elbows to knees.
3. Complete as many valid reps as possible in the given time.
sitUps.sourceFileDetails: Compiled from: Khelo India/SAI Basketball Retention & Induction Protocol, Volleyball Selection Criteria, SAI Battery Fitness Assessment Concept Note.

endurance800m.name: 800m Endurance Run (U12)
endurance800m.whyItMatters: Measures cardiovascular endurance for younger athletes.
endurance800m.instructions:
1. Start behind the line on a measured track.
2. Run or walk 800 meters as fast as possible.
3. Stop the timer when crossing the 800m finish line.
endurance800m.sourceFileDetails: Compiled from: Khelo India/SAI Basketball Retention & Induction Protocol, Volleyball Selection Criteria, SAI Battery Fitness Assessment Concept Note.

endurance1600m.name: 1.6km Endurance Run (12+)
endurance1600m.whyItMatters: Measures cardiovascular endurance and aerobic pacing capability.
endurance1600m.instructions:
1. Start behind the line on a measured track.
2. Run or walk 1.6km as fast as possible.
3. Stop the timer when crossing the finish line.
endurance1600m.sourceFileDetails: Compiled from: Khelo India/SAI Basketball Retention & Induction Protocol, Volleyball Selection Criteria, SAI Battery Fitness Assessment Concept Note.
